name: Kylie Granger
source:
Owns Darren's building. 

Friends with Connie Frankland.

She has ties to the criminal underworld of London. 

[spoiler]Darren rescued Kylie from a previous abusive relationship. Thus she takes a very extreme stance towards domestic abusers.[spoiler]

[spoiler]Due to Kylie's past as a victim of domestic abuse, Kylie will offer to permanently resolve the "Marissa" issue. This is instead than just stealing Marissa's hard drive with the photos/videos of Steph forced humiliation and Marissa's abuse towards Steph. This interaction is only available when you are on the Steph relationship route.[spoiler]
